verdict.rationale: Agents can read and post channel messages through Buzz's own interfaces. The relay speaks NIP-29/NIP-42 directly to clients, the official CLI and the buzz-acp harness let agents listen for @mentions and reply, and the managed buzz-cli skill covers messaging and channels. Each agent gets its own keypair, channel memberships and audit trail, and NIP-AA makes agent access depend on the owner's membership. However, credentials are Nostr keypairs scoped by channel membership rather than scoped API tokens: no permission scopes such as read-only versus post are documented, token auth was deliberately removed from the admin API, and there is no REST/OpenAPI message API. Missing for 10: scoped tokens or per-capability permission scopes, a documented HTTP/REST message read/post API (OpenAPI probes 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
